_comment: BUG-002 investigation, step 5 of the fix/investigation plan (bug-reports/BUG-002-...md, 'Fix and investigation plan'): both motor-mounted channels stay bidirectional (so both lines still release on every frame, unlike step 4's unidirectional scenario), but only channel 1 (pin 6) is commanded to a real throttle (100) - channel 3 (pin 8) holds 0 throttle the whole run, so it never actually spins or switches phases, even though its line still releases and its receiver still runs. This isolates whether BUG-002 needs a SECOND motor actually spinning and switching phases nearby, or whether a second released/floating bidirectional line is enough by itself even if that motor is idle. Only motor 0's telemetry is a valid signal: motor 2, held at 0 throttle throughout, legitimately replies the same 0xFFF/917 sentinel as BUG-002's symptom even when everything is working correctly, so its eRPM is NOT checked - only motor 0's CRC-valid rate and median eRPM tell us anything here. Channels 2 and 4 idle (no motor mounted).
